firm_data.firm_description: Faegre Drinker Biddle & Reath LLP is a full-service law firm handling complex transactions, litigation, and regulatory work for multinational businesses. They provide services to clients and understand their priorities, bring fresh ideas that work, and deliver excellence without arrogance.
notable_facts: The firm has 1,200 experienced attorneys and consulting professionals.
Faegre Drinker Consulting provides public policy, regulatory and technical services.
Additional services include Tritura Information Governance and Innovative Health Strategies.
technology_signals: The firm is leveraging AI, automation, and data analytics to transform legal service delivery.
The firm established a client-focused, award-winning digital innovation center in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, deploying automation, generative and agentic AI and data analytics.

ai_contact.name: Shawn M. Swearingen
ai_contact.title: Chief Innovation Officer
ai_contact.ai_notes: Shawn Swearingen develops, champions and leads strategic innovation initiatives related to data science and analytics, client and practice technologies, and knowledge management.

email.subject: AI for Faegre Drinker, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Nolan,

Your digital innovation center in Pittsburgh is leading the way on generative and agentic AI deployment across complex transactions and litigation. We're seeing the same momentum across BigLaw firms managing massive client demands with precision automation.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms facing exactly these demands. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on what matters most: precision, client trust, and efficiency without friction.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're expanding to meet regional firms like yours. I'd be happy to stop by your office to share how ex-lawyers are helping similar firms compete with BigLaw on speed and quality.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
